Question: What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
What is the loss ratio of each policy and agent who sold it by policy number and agent id?
Generated Query:
SELECT
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier AS Agent_Id,
    CAST(COALESCE(SUM(lp_claims.Loss_Amount), 0) AS decimal(18,2)) /
        NULLIF(CAST(COALESCE(SUM(prm.Premium_Amount), 0) AS decimal(18,2)), 0) AS Loss_Ratio
FROM Policy p
JOIN Agreement_Party_Role apr
    ON apr.Agreement_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
   AND apr.Party_Role_Code = 'AGENT'
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier,
        SUM(ca.Claim_Amount) AS Loss_Amount
    FROM Claim c
    JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
        ON cc.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Claim_Amount ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    JOIN Loss_Payment lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier,
        cc.Effective_Date,
        c.Claim_Identifier
) lp_claims
    ON EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd
        WHERE pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
          AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = lp_claims.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
          AND pcd.Effective_Date = lp_claims.Effective_Date
    )
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        pa.Policy_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS Premium_Amount
    FROM Policy_Amount pa
    JOIN Premium pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY
        pa.Policy_Identifier
) prm
    ON prm.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier
ORDER BY
    p.Policy_Number,
    apr.Party_Identifier;

Question: What are the total loss, which is the sum of loss payment, loss reserve, expense payment, expense reserve amount by catastrophe and policy number?

    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    c.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Loss_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Payment_Amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS Expense_Reserve_Amount,
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR er.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
            THEN COALESCE(ca.Claim_Amount, 0)
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS Total_Loss
FROM Claim c1
JOIN Catastrophe c
    ON c1.Catastrophe_Identifier = c.Catastrophe_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Amount ca
    ON c1.Claim_Identifier = ca.Claim_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Payment lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Loss_Reserve lr
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Payment ep
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ep.Claim_Amount_Identifier
LEFT JOIN Expense_Reserve er
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = er.Claim_Amount_Identifier
JOIN Claim_Coverage cc
    ON c1.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
JOIN Policy_Coverage_Detail pcd

   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
JOIN Policy p
    ON pcd.Policy_Identifier = p.Policy_Identifier
GROUP BY
    c.Catastrophe_Identifier,
    c.Catastrophe_Name,
    p.Policy_Number
ORDER BY
